test.title: Three cafés in the town centre

texts.title: Three cafés in the town centre

paragraphs.text: The Green Cup, on Market Street, serves only vegetarian food and bakes all its bread on the premises. It is small, with just eight tables, so it does not take bookings, and there are often queues at lunchtime.
Harbour Lights is a larger café with views over the water. It is popular with families because it has a children’s menu and a play area, and it stays open until 9 pm in summer.
Café Roma is known for its coffee, which it roasts itself. It offers a 10 per cent discount to customers who bring their own cup, and its upstairs room can be booked free of charge for meetings.

Harbour Lights and Café Roma both have step-free access, while The Green Cup is up a short flight of stairs. The Green Cup is also the only one of the three that does not accept cards. All three cafés offer free Wi-Fi.

document.title: Three cafés in the town centre

items.quote: its upstairs room can be booked free of charge for meetings
items.prompt: has a room that groups can use

explanation.en: Café Roma’s “upstairs room can be booked free of charge for meetings” → C. The Green Cup takes no bookings at all.
explanation.kk: Café Roma-ның «upstairs room can be booked free of charge for meetings» → C. Green Cup-та үстел мүлде брондалмайды.
explanation.ru: У Café Roma «upstairs room can be booked free of charge for meetings» → C. Столики в Green Cup не бронируют вовсе.

items.quote: The Green Cup is up a short flight of stairs
items.prompt: is hard to enter for people who use a wheelchair

explanation.en: The other two have “step-free access”, while “The Green Cup is up a short flight of stairs” → A.
explanation.kk: Қалған екі кафеде «step-free access» бар, ал «The Green Cup is up a short flight of stairs» → A.
explanation.ru: У двух других кафе «step-free access», а «The Green Cup is up a short flight of stairs» → A.

items.quote: bakes all its bread on the premises

explanation.en: The Green Cup “bakes all its bread on the premises” → A. Café Roma roasts its own coffee, not bread. A appears twice — there is an NB.
explanation.kk: Green Cup «bakes all its bread on the premises» → A. Café Roma кофені өзі қуырады, нанды емес. A әрпі екінші рет — NB бар.
explanation.ru: Green Cup «bakes all its bread on the premises» → A. Café Roma сама обжаривает кофе, но не хлеб. Буква A второй раз — есть NB.

items.quote: it has a children’s menu and a play area
items.prompt: has somewhere for young children to play

explanation.en: Only Harbour Lights has a play area: “it has a children’s menu and a play area”, which is why families like it → B.
explanation.kk: Балалар алаңы тек Harbour Lights-та бар: «it has a children’s menu and a play area». Бұл кафе отбасылар арасында танымал деп аталған → B.
explanation.ru: Детская площадка есть только у Harbour Lights: «it has a children’s menu and a play area». Это кафе и называют популярным у семей → B.

items.quote: It offers a 10 per cent discount to customers who bring their own cup
items.prompt: rewards customers who help to reduce waste

explanation.en: A discount for customers “who bring their own cup” — reusing a cup cuts waste → C.
explanation.kk: «who bring their own cup» дегендерге жеңілдік — бір реттік стақанның орнына өз кесесі қалдықты азайтады → C.
explanation.ru: Скидка тем, «who bring their own cup», — своя чашка вместо одноразовой уменьшает отходы → C.
